steps.title: Sketch the flange circle
steps.command: 3D Model tab > Sketch panel > Start 2D Sketch
actions: File > New > Standard (mm).ipt to start a new part.
Start 2D Sketch on the XZ Plane (the top).
Add the dimensions with Dimension (Sketch tab > Constrain panel): diameter 120. Click Finish Sketch.

steps.title: Extrude the flange
actions: Click Extrude. Distance A: 15 mm, upwards. Click OK.

steps.title: Sketch and extrude the hub
actions: Start 2D Sketch on the top face of the flange. Circle on the centre, diameter 50. Finish Sketch.
Extrude. Distance A: 20 mm, upwards. Boolean: Join. Click OK.

steps.title: Bore the 30 mm hole
actions: Click Hole, click the top face of the hub, then click its circular edge to make the hole concentric.
Simple Hole. Diameter 30 mm. Termination: Through All. Click OK.

steps.title: Drill one hole on the PCD
actions: Start 2D Sketch on the top face of the flange. Draw a construction circle of diameter 90 (the PCD).
Sketch tab > Create panel > Point: put a point on the PCD, in line with the X axis. Finish Sketch.
Hole: pick the point. Simple Hole. Diameter 10 mm. Through All. Click OK.

steps.title: Pattern six holes
steps.command: 3D Model tab > Pattern panel > Circular Pattern
actions: Click Circular Pattern. Features: the 10 mm hole. Rotation Axis: the bore.
Placement: 6 occurrences over 360 degrees, so they are 60 degrees apart. Click OK.

steps.title: Chamfer the bore
actions: Click Chamfer. Distance 1.5 mm. Pick the top edge of the bore. Click OK.
